import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {
    'main': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
    'rel': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
}

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    print("FILES IN ARCHIVE:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print(" ", n)
    print()

    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = wb.findall(".//main:sheet", NS)
    print("SHEETS:")
    for s in sheets:
        print(" ", s.get("name"), s.get("sheetId"), s.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id"))
    print()

    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in rels}
    print("RELS:", rel_map)
    print()

    shared = None
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in z.namelist():
        sst = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        shared = []
        for si in sst.findall("main:si", NS):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
            shared.append(text)

    for s in sheets:
        rid = s.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id")
        target = rel_map.get(rid)
        sheet_path = "xl/" + target.lstrip("/")
        if not sheet_path.startswith("xl/"):
            sheet_path = "xl/" + target
        print(f"=== Sheet {s.get('name')} -> {sheet_path} ===")
        data = ET.fromstring(z.read(sheet_path))
        rows = {}
        for c in data.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}c"):
            ref = c.get("r")
            t = c.get("t")
            v = c.find("main:v", NS)
            val = v.text if v is not None else ""
            if t == "s" and v is not None and shared is not None:
                val = shared[int(v.text)]
            elif t == "inlineStr":
                isel = c.find("main:is", NS)
                val = "".join(tx.text or "" for tx in isel.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t")) if isel is not None else ""
            elif t == "b":
                val = v.text == "1" if v is not None else ""
            rows[ref] = val
        # sort by row/col
        def key(ref):
            m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref)
            col = 0
            for ch in m.group(1):
                col = col * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
            return (int(m.group(2)), col)
        for ref in sorted(rows, key=key):
            print(f"  {ref}: {rows[ref]!r}")
        print()

import zipfile
with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    xml = z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8")
print(xml)
